message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & memory model**
- Expert-tiered memory: hot experts in VRAM, overflow in pinned RAM, remainder streamed from NVMe SSD via mmap; CPU lane computes RAM-tier experts when faster than PCIe.
- Multi-GPU layer splitting (up to 16 GPUs), auto split search pricing
